scope: Windows 11 development host, disposable workspaces, isolated WebView2 profile. No real provider or production desktop profile.
before: Regression tests reproduced three failures on the prior implementation: a second close bypassed a failed write, an in-flight manual save did not protect the tab, and a failed Save as new lost the original archive ID/revision.

checks: Two successive new-chat attempts after a disk revision conflict kept the transcript on Escape and Keep.

Closing from B offered recovery for A. Keeping left the archive byte-identical. Save as new preserved the externally written revision 2 and saved local text as an independent revision 1; B draft survived.
An obstructed .dalizi directory caused a real save error. Discard left the blocker untouched, retry after removing it persisted only the later conversation.
Pinned chat history refused to replace unsaved text on Keep. Explicit discard restored the selected original revision; the archive bytes remained identical.
Two failing folder conversations shared a tab. Discarding the first and keeping the second cancelled the close; the next attempt asked about the first again.

verification.build: Verified every extracted source file against its inventory; offline MSVC release from that extraction using a shared target cache. Per-file ZIP hashes, exact executable, Cargo.lock, and bundled runtime manifest verified.

limits: In-app tab and conversation changes only. Unsent drafts and an entire application quit/crash are outside the archive recovery guarantee.
Frozen M5 RC6 still requires clean Windows 10 and 11 acceptance and an authenticated model turn.
